"""Coverage form for env_reads_outside_settings (G0 review finding 3): `import os.path` binds
the plain name `os` in the importing module even though there is no `as` name, so the read below
must still be reported."""

import os.path


def read() -> str:
    """VIOLATION: env_reads_outside_settings, through `import os.path`."""
    return os.environ["X"]
